Berries and poultry were linked with healthier brain changes, while sweets and fried fast foods were associated with greater tissue loss.

items.title: Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 may have a reversible weakness
items.content: The Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 may actively damage brain blood vessels and sabotage the cellular systems that remove harmful proteins. Researchers were able to reverse some of these effects in experiments, revealing promising new targets for Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and other neurodegenerative diseases.
